name: numeriduel-web

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-vendor-design-system.cjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-replay.mjs && node scripts/scan-hardcoded-i18n.mjs && node scripts/scan-html-i18n.mjs && node scripts/scan-lang-leak.mjs && node scripts/bump-dict-version.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-sitemap.mjs --check && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-brand.mjs && node scripts/copy-legacy.mjs
